name: diagram-viewer
title: Diagram viewer
description: DiagramViewer, DiagramView and diagramKind: an agent's *.diagram.json (format v1, versioned: nodes, edges, optional groups, highlighted path and note) as boxes and numbered arrows with a legend that says what happens and who acts. Layers run left to right while they fit and top to bottom on a phone, scrolling inside their own box; no layout library. A superset of a maquette's workflow, which the maquette viewer draws with DiagramView. The pi-app artifact panel shows .diagram.json files with it by default; app artifactKinds win.
